# Syn-Forge

Syn-Forge is the software developer portfolio of Operator-Syn.

## Public Portfolio MCP (Streamable HTTP)

Syn-Forge provides a public, read-only Model Context Protocol server for agents that need grounded portfolio information.

- Endpoint: https://mcp.syn-forge.com/mcp
- Server name: syn-forge-portfolio
- Human guide: https://syn-forge.com/ai
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Authentication: none for the current public surface
- Writes: none

The server exposes structured overview, project, certificate, and public snippet information. Markdown snippets can be read in bounded chunks; PDF snippets expose metadata and canonical links.

- Tools: get_portfolio_overview, search_portfolio, list_projects, get_project, list_certificates, get_certificate, list_snippets, read_snippet
- Resources: portfolio://overview, portfolio://projects, portfolio://certificates, portfolio://snippets

## Canonical portfolio pages

- Home: https://syn-forge.com/
- Projects: https://syn-forge.com/projects
- Certificates: https://syn-forge.com/certificates
- Snippets: https://syn-forge.com/snippets
- Privacy policy: https://syn-forge.com/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://syn-forge.com/terms-and-conditions

Agents should cite these canonical pages, distinguish published evidence from inference, and avoid inventing employers, clients, metrics, or skills.
